registered_in: a Mac rehearsal of the gate's scripts (rehearsal), never evidence
batching: every arm is played in the batched path, 32 games per worker. A batch changes float rounding in the matrix products, so a rare game differs from its unbatched twin: D434's contrasts (one game per worker) stay a descriptive comparison

mask_definition.m1: END_TURN is removed from the masked seat's exact joint support while an ACTIVATE is also legal; the policy is renormalized over what is left (play_harness/policy.py restrict_support, MaskedPolicySeat)

sampling_offsets: none: no pair has the same checkpoint on both sides

pair_notes.1: c55d1l1 v chain37: chain 55 fine-tuned by recipe R1 at lambda 1.0, under m1 (the registered arm)
pair_notes.2: c55d1l4 v chain37: chain 55 fine-tuned by recipe R1 at lambda 4.0, under m1
pair_notes.3: c55d1l16 v chain37: chain 55 fine-tuned by recipe R1 at lambda 16.0, under m1
pair_notes.4: c55m1 v chain37: the control, chain 55 under m1
pair_notes.5: c55d1l1 v chain46: chain 55 fine-tuned by recipe R1 at lambda 1.0, under m1 (the registered arm)
pair_notes.6: c55d1l4 v chain46: chain 55 fine-tuned by recipe R1 at lambda 4.0, under m1
pair_notes.7: c55d1l16 v chain46: chain 55 fine-tuned by recipe R1 at lambda 16.0, under m1
pair_notes.8: c55m1 v chain46: the control, chain 55 under m1

selection.rule: the registered arm is the eligible arm with the highest J; ties go to the smaller lambda; an arm whose J is not finite, or whose blob fails its acceptance, is not eligible; with no eligible arm there is no registered arm, the gate is not played and the plan stops unread

launch.rule: refuses unless this file hashes to the committed sha256, both checkouts are clean at their commits, every checkpoint blob and sidecar has its registered sha256, the runner is the registered one, and the shards' index slices cover every pair exactly once from index 0

merge: tools/droplet_tournament.py merge --out <run_dir> --shard <each shard>/main (shards must share commit, seed block, settings, torch and compiled shim; a pair's index slices must be disjoint and cover it from index 0 without a gap)

acceptance.against: this file, whose sha256 is committed to the ledger before launch

scoring.rule: merge, then accept_from_plan.py (four checks), then the report, the contrasts, the reading and the diagnostics only if accepted

statistic: decisive-Elo with 95% seed-cluster intervals from play_harness.tournament_stats (report.json, report.txt), 2,000 replicates

sets.name: label: the registered arm c55d1l1 minus c55m1
descriptive dose-response, no label: c55d1l4 minus c55m1
descriptive dose-response, no label: c55d1l16 minus c55m1

reading.statistic: the registered arm minus C against chain 37 and against chain 46, decisive-Elo, 95% seed-cluster intervals
reading.Unread: a contrast or an end of its interval is missing or not finite
reading.Negative: either interval entirely below zero (upper end below 0)
reading.Positive: both point estimates at +15 or more and both intervals entirely above zero (lower end above 0)
reading.Flat: both intervals inside -15 to +15, ends included

diagnostics.registered: the style table per side for the eight pairs, and the share of seed-legs where an arm's game is C's game
